offline: The Amiga is not answering. Trying again…
disconnected: Lost the connection to Amigent. Trying again…
send_tip: Copy files from this PC to the Amiga
panel: Show or hide the keyboard panel
drop_here: Drop to send to the Amiga
mod_tip: Click: for the next key. Double-click: stays on.
kb_direct_tip: Sends key positions, held keys stay held, for games
type_hint: The text goes to the active window, line breaks press Return.
restart_text: Open files are written to disk first. Unsaved work in programs is lost.
about_text: Your real Amiga, live on this computer, with mouse and keyboard, even over a slow network.
thanks_text: tbdye for amigactld (GPLv3), Volker Barthelmann for vbcc
pc_outdated: The Amiga has a newer Amigent than this PC. Update it here too: pipx upgrade amigent
rel_mouse_tip: Captures the mouse and sends its movement, for games. Esc releases it.
fleet_hint: Each Amiga is checked every 20 seconds. Manage Amigas renames them, changes addresses or picks the default.
get_tip: Copy files from the Amiga to this PC
clip_get_tip: Copy the Amiga's clipboard to this PC
clip_put_tip: Put this PC's clipboard on the Amiga's clipboard
clip_got: Copied the Amiga's clipboard to this PC.
clip_put_done: On the Amiga's clipboard. Paste with Right Amiga+V.
fleet_run_placeholder: An AmigaDOS command for every Amiga, e.g. Version
pause_hint: The Amiga stops reading its screen, so a test or benchmark has the CPU to itself. Mouse, keys and files keep working.
paused: Picture paused on the Amiga, {time} left. Mouse and keys still work.
output_moved: The picture is now on the Amiga's own video output ({mode}), not on the graphics card's.
output_limit_dualpf: Dual playfield screens show here only in part.
output_limit_planar: Sprites and colour changes during the picture (copper) don't show here.
output_limit_own_view: The program shows a display of its own; this picture is the Intuition screen behind it.
noos_title: A program without the operating system is running
noos_body: {program}, started {time}. The Amiga's network is off until it quits; Amigent reconnects by itself. Nothing is wrong.
noos_key: To quit it, press {key} on the Amiga's own keyboard.
noos_key_usual: To quit it, press its quit key on the Amiga's own keyboard, usually F10.
capture_intro: A USB HDMI capture stick shows the Amiga's own video output here, for programs without the operating system and chipset screens. Only for looking; mouse and keys don't go through it.
capture_auto: Switch to it by itself for programs without the OS and for chipset screens
capture_pill_noos: Capture device · the Amiga's OS is off
capture_failed: The capture device gives no picture.
capture_no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg is needed to read the capture device. Install it, then search again.
capture_no_devices: No capture device found. Plug it in, then search again.
update_running: Updating Amigent. The window closes and opens again by itself.
update_failed: The update did not work. Details in update.log in the Amigent settings folder.
machines_connect_to: Connect by saved name or address
machines_one_off: Connecting to an address does not add or change a saved Amiga.
machines_remove_hint: Remove this Amiga from the list? Its credentials and history will be kept.
machines_address_hint: This changes the saved address for this Amiga. An address already assigned to another Amiga cannot be used.
machines_rename_hint: Credentials, notes, and installation history stay with this Amiga.
machines_empty: No saved Amigas yet. Use amigent-setup to register one, or connect by address below.
machines_unavailable: Cannot reach the local machine manager. Reopen amigent-viewer.
panel_hint: Your PC keyboard types on the Amiga while the picture has focus. In full screen the Windows keys are the Amiga keys.
panel_hint_mac: Your Mac keyboard types on the Amiga while the picture has focus. Cmd is the Right Amiga key.
shell_hint: These go to the active Shell window.
game_mode_tip: Captures the mouse, sends keys directly
game_pill: Game mode: mouse and keys go straight to the Amiga
hold_right_hint: Hold right button keeps an Amiga menu open while you move the pointer.
version_line: {pc} on this PC · amigentd {amiga} on the Amiga
amiga_outdated: The Amiga runs an older amigentd than this PC knows. Update it with amigent-setup --update.
get_pick: Select a file, then Get. A double-click gets it at once.
sc_paste: Types your PC's clipboard on the Amiga
sc_paste_mac: Types your Mac's clipboard on the Amiga
sc_amiga: Left and Right Amiga. The menu key is Right Amiga too.
sc_amiga_mac: Right Amiga, for shortcuts such as Cmd+O
sc_full: Takes the keyboard lock in Chrome and Edge, so system keys go to the Amiga. Hold Esc to leave.
sck_pgup: Page Up, Page Down, Home, End
sc_pgup: Shift with a cursor key, as Amiga editors expect
sc_altgr: Types the character it makes on your keyboard, such as @ or €
sc_esc: Releases the captured mouse and leaves game mode
sck_lock: Double-click a modifier in the panel
sc_lock: Keeps it on until the next click, its LED gets long
sc_type: Types the text in the Type text window
reason_key_wanted: amigentd wants a key: run amigent-setup, or set AMIGENT_KEY.
reason_key_refused: amigentd refused the key; AMIGENT_KEY or the key in ~/.config/amigent/ must match S:amigent.key on the Amiga.
reason_unexpected_greeting: The Amiga sent an unexpected greeting.
reason_timeout: The Amiga did not answer in time.
reason_unreachable: The Amiga cannot be reached on the network.
reason_closed: The connection to the Amiga was closed.
reason_unresolved: The Amiga's address could not be resolved.
reason_plain_closed: amigentd takes only encrypted connections from other computers. Copy its certificate (tls-<id>.pem → tls-<address>.pem in ~/.config/amigent/ on the PC that set it up) to this one, or run amigent-setup again.
reason_no_tls: amigentd runs TLSONLY, but AmiSSL does not open there, so it turns every other computer away. Repair it at the Amiga: install AmiSSL again and run amigent-repair from the Amigent folder, or start amigentd SETUP there and run amigent-setup again.
reason_no_certificate: amigentd runs TLSONLY and AmiSSL works, but S:amigent-tls.pem does not load, so its encrypted port is closed and every other computer is turned away. Repair it at the Amiga: delete S:amigent-tls.pem and run amigent-repair from the Amigent folder, or start amigentd SETUP there and run amigent-setup again.
reason_tls_mismatch: The Amiga's TLS certificate does not match the saved one; run amigent-setup again.
reason_pin_ambiguous: Two saved Amigas share this address and their TLS certificates differ; fix the address in Your Amigas or run amigent-setup again.
reason_machine_changed: Machine changed; select it again in Your Amigas.
